items.text: Saquon Barkley is back for Week 7 and 'in line to play' Monday vs DAL; efficient in full games played this season with strong RB matchup.
items.why: Returned to practice; Berry views as RB15 with efficiency and Dallas matchup.
items.implication: Startable RB2/flex immediately; reverse any prior handcuff/beneficiary starts.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone/ dual-threat usage returns; Eagles need him post-Hurts season-ending.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and will be listed as limited.
items.why: Left early with calf; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; high target share post-Adams makes any absence massive for Rams WR depth and Stafford.
items.opportunity: If OUT, elevated routes/targets for remaining Rams WRs/TE; already 25+ tgt pace noted previously.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially did not practice for a second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Rising risk of missing Week 7; monitor for Q/OUT Friday.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and others see elevated targets/snaps if OUT.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice (limited) Thursday after prior DNP; not ruled out for Week 7.
items.why: Returned limited after Wednesday DNP quad.
items.implication: Game-time or Friday upgrade possible; Braelon Allen remains primary if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If active full, reclaims lead carries/routes; else Allen elevated.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP; also TE Elijah Arroyo season-ending shoulder surgery/IR.
items.why: Activated from PUP after full practice progress; Arroyo IR season-ending.
items.implication: Charbonnet immediately in mix; could compress Kenneth Walker III and others' snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Committee likely; Walker handcuff value drops, Charbonnet waiver/roster priority rises for SEA RB shares.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers—OL mess too. Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive step; backups poor EPA data supports Jacobs role upon return.
items.implication: ROS value holds; startable soon if cleared, backups not viable long-term.
items.opportunity: Lead carries/red-zone likely reclaimed; monitor practice full clearance.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (limited ankle, second straight day limited).
items.why: Present and limited after prior absence notes; day-to-day.
items.implication: Trending toward possible return vs CIN; boosts Flowers/Andrews if active.
items.opportunity: Full practice Friday key; Huntley otherwise.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson (IR eligible) not expected ready soon ('will take some time'); Rams answer now 25 Puka Nacua targets per game post-Adams.
items.why: Ferguson delay leaves Puka as primary; prior high tgt share data.
items.implication: Elite WR1 volume locked if healthy; calf now clouds short-term.
items.opportunity: Massive routes/targets/red-zone; conflict with new calf if limited/out.
items.conflict: New calf injury may reduce immediate opportunity.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS landing spot could alter value/schedule; hold for now.
items.opportunity: If traded to contender, usage/upside boost possible.

items.text: Patriots CB Christian Gonzalez downgraded to questionable (illness) then ruled active for TNF vs CHI.
items.why: Illness downgrade then active on inactives.
items.implication: No fantasy offensive impact but confirms availability.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown (@CHI, WR10 usage/matchup), DeVonta Smith (vs DAL elite volume), Tucker Kraft (@DET), Jaylen Warren (@NO workload/matchup), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB consistency), Bucky Irving (@CAR), Jordan Love (@DET shootout).
items.why: Bears soft for yardage; Lions pass-catcher buffet; big workloads + friendly run D matchups; Packers-Lions points.
items.implication: Strong start recommendations Week 7 based on usage + matchup.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes/carries/red-zone in projected high-scoring or soft spots.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (vs NE), Josh Downs (@MIN target-share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (@SEA tough D), Josh Jacobs (@DET workload question post-layoff), Cam Skattebo (@HOU brutal spot).
items.why: Nasty matchups, role/target issues, layoff workload questions, tough spots.
items.implication: Sit or fade Week 7; Jacobs specifically post-absence concern.
items.conflict: Conflicts with Levitan positive Jacobs facility/EPA notes on backups.

items.text: Pat Thorman Week 7 rankings live (updates Fri/Sun); free Snaps & Pace on main-slate matchups (TB/CAR up, MIA/NYJ slog, GB/DET/LAR/LV high volume) plus team notes CLE/DEN/NO/PHI/PIT/TEN. ROS Top-150 and waivers available.
items.why: Opportunity/pace focus; free article this week.
items.implication: Use for start/sit, volume projections; high-pace games boost skill players.
items.opportunity: Prioritize players in up-tempo/high-volume projected games.

items.text: JJ McCarthy starting for Giants; YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 vs 9.9-10.8 for prior QBs (Mullens/Cousins/Darnold/Wentz). Different scheme/coaches/sample but concerning.
items.why: Data shows sharp YPT drop with McCarthy; room for improvement but tough to ignore.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency/ROS ceiling risk; still elite talent but volume may not convert as well short-term.
items.opportunity: Monitor routes/targets vs HOU; scheme fit key.
